NOTIFICATION MADE UNDER SECTION 66(D) OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTES
ELECTION ORDINANCE AMENDED BY LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTES ELECTIONS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 22 OF 2012

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 66(d) of the Local Government Institute Election Ordinance amended byLocal Government Institutes Election (Amendment) Act No. 22 of 2012, I, J. M. R. P. Jayasinghe the Commissioner of LocalGovernment in the North Western Province, hereby notify that the first meeting will be convened for the purpose of electingMayor/Chairman, Deputy Mayor/ Vice Chairman for the Local Government Institutions set out in the following schedule atthe respective venue, time and date correspondingly specified in the following schedule itself.
J. M. R. P. JAYASINGHE,Commissioner of Local Government,
North Western Province.
Department of Local Government (NWP),2nd Floor, B Entrance,Provincial Council Office Complex,16th March, 2018,
